body:
## Parent and order

Parent: #440 — TSW Release Updates, Component Updates and Selective Installation.
Work package: **LCM-W02**, execution position 2/10.
Requirements: **LCM-01, LCM-02, LCM-04, LCM-05** from #440.
Initial scope: supported Classic on native Linux and WSL2.

## Goal

Implement the installation manifest and component version catalog for the operator workflows defined by #440, reusing the existing hexagonal architecture and lifecycle boundaries.

## Dependencies

- #441 — LCM-W01

## Scope

- Implement a versioned manifest for installation identity, TSW release/revision, selected/resolved services, component desired/observed versions and credential-source references.
- Define service schema, compatibility policy, migration ownership and integration with #318.
- Persist state atomically with interruption handling and drift diagnostics; never persist credential values.
- Define safe adoption of existing installations and explicit rejection of ambiguous state.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] LCM-W02-AC1: Schema validation and migration tests cover existing, unknown and corrupt state.
- [ ] LCM-W02-AC2: Manifest reads are non-mutating; writes are atomic and preserve unrelated operator configuration.
- [ ] LCM-W02-AC3: Installed/desired version drift is explicit, including resolved image identity.
- [ ] LCM-W02-AC4: Existing installations can be adopted through a documented supported path or blocked with actionable diagnostics.

## Validation and evidence

- Map each acceptance ID to the affected architecture contract, meaningful tests and evidence.
- Run targeted tests and applicable QUALITY.md gates. Cover invalid input, read-only preview, no-op and relevant failure paths.
- For mutating workflows verify CLI help, argument validation and existing live-consent behavior.
- Separate unit/mock results from actual live qualification; W09 owns the cross-host matrix and consumes each slice's results.
- Record exact tested SHA, host/profile, product/component versions, resolved service selection, commands, exit codes and redacted before/after observations for live claims.
- Missing, skipped, stale or inconclusive required checks remain non-pass.

## Boundaries and completion

Follow current AGENTS.md, QUALITY.md, documentation/process/issue-completion-discipline.md and documentation/process/verification-state-policy.md. Reuse #297 where relevant; coordinate model ownership with #318 and architecture with #313/#314. Do not build a parallel orchestrator, reopen completed #297 scope, or introduce unqualified Podman/Kubernetes behavior.

Portainer and Incus/LXC remain mandatory Classic foundations. No silent destructive reset, data deletion or credential rotation. Issue creation does not authorize live infrastructure mutations.

Complete when the bounded deliverables, acceptance criteria, tests, operator documentation and required evidence are reviewable and the remaining supported-scope limits are explicit.
title: [LCM-W02] Implement the installation manifest and component version catalog
